description: The Home Energy Assessment Database API is code for combining household attributes with energy and emissions factors for home-energy tools. Climate Cooperative's README names local grid mix, weather, building age, size, materials and mechanical systems as intended inputs. It describes a REST service connected to a separate home-energy calculator and future savings tools. Users configure data sources and submit housing information; outputs are assessment data for downstream calculations. Geographic coverage depends on the weather, building and electricity sources connected to an installation. GitHub metadata states Apache-2.0 licensing for the software. A limitation is that the README frames several integrations and calculations as future goals; it does not establish a complete, verified nationwide database or accurate savings predictions. This prototype can support building-stock energy scenario preparation when its inputs and implementation are checked. The related Brightway catalogue platform models life-cycle inventories, not this API. No home records, source datasets or service package were downloaded.
name: Home Energy Assessment Database API
notes: G7 G7-1740. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. README describes future integrations; draft does not claim a complete live database.
